parts:
Thanks for stepping in Jonah, somehow I had missed Eugene's question.

Eugene, can you send me the result of versioninfo() and Pkg.status()? Just send the info directly to me: goe...@icloud.com

My first guess is a mismatch of package versions, in this casee Mamba.jl and StatsFuns.jl. The latter was recently refactored (from Distributions I believe). Pkg.update() in the REPL might fix that.

Regards,
Rob
